FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHILD WELFARE AND SPECIAL
SERVICES
DISTRICT CHILD PROTECTION UNIT, DINDIGUL
PRESS RELEASE
Applications are Invited for Support Persons to Provide
Care and Assistance to Child Victims in POCSO Cases
As per G.O. (Ms) No. 23, dated 12.08.2026 of the
Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department,
Tamil Nadu, applications are invited for selecting "Support
Persons" in Dindigul District for the purpose of assisting
the victims under the POCSO Act, 2012 and POCSO Rules,
2020. Coordinating with Police, Child Welfare Committee,
District Child Protection Unit, Hospitals, and Courts to
provide medical aid, psychological support, education,
rehabilitation, and case progress information.
Vacancies & Eligibility:
o Position: Support Persons
o No. of Posts: 20
o Educational Qualification: Post Graduate degree
in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child
Development or any other relevant field related to
Child Welfare, Health, or Education; OR a
graduate with minimum of three years experience
in child education, development, health or
protection issues.
o Age Limit: Minimum 25 years.
Applications are invited from eligible and interested
applicants for empanelling as Support Persons, subjected
to the prescribed eligibility criteria, rules and conditions as
per the Government order. Also the tenure for empanelling
a Support Persons is 3 years. An honorarium of ₹10,000/-
per case (including travel expenses) will be provided as per
the Government order.
Eligible and interested applicants or organization shall
download the application from www.dindigul.nic.in and
submit the photo attached filled application with
educational qualification certificates, experience
certificates, Police verification certificate and all relevant
documents within 15 days of this publication in person or
by post to the office address given below. Applications
received after the deadline, incompletely filled applications
or applications submitted without the relevant/necessary
supporting documents will not be accepted.
Address for submission of the application:
District Child Protection Officer,
District Child Protection Office,
Blessings, Plot No. 4, 2nd Cross Street (First Floor),
S.P.R. Nagar, Collectorate Post, Dindigul – 624 004.
Ph: 0451 - 2904070
District Collector,
Dindigul.
